items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I'd made a record for Jazztone with Jonah Jones

ctx.x: One other time he asked me to do a television show with him...a morning talk show. And I did this talk show with him. But other than that...and then a strange thing...a few months later he called me and says, "You know what," he says, "You're losing one of your best friends." I didn't know what the hell he was talking about. But he had cancer. And I said, "Well, so what." You know. I always, you know, turned him off like that. "So what. So I'm losing one of my best friends. If you're talking about yourself,…

Shortly after he died I decided that I'd had it in music. So then I got out again. In 1954...when did he die? He died in '67. Yeah, '67, yeah. Well, in 1954, I went...I'd made a record for Jazztone with Jonah Jones and...
